from pathlib import Path
import re,subprocess,yaml,json,hashlib
class UniqueLoader(yaml.SafeLoader): pass
def unique_mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
 out={}
 for k,v in node.value:
  key=loader.construct_object(k,deep=deep)
  if key in out: raise ValueError('duplicate YAML key: '+key)
  out[key]=loader.construct_object(v,deep=deep)
 return out
UniqueLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,unique_mapping)
status=yaml.load(Path('_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml').read_text(),Loader=UniqueLoader)['development_status']

named={k.removeprefix('named-').upper() for k in status if k.startswith('named-')}
